About Reserv
Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

We are seeking a highly organized and customer-focused Transportation Claims Total Loss Specialist to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for working with rental facilities, body shops, salvage vendors, and appraisers to manage the total loss settlement process and rental expenses, reviewing the valuation of the vehicle based on its type to resolve the claim efficiently and reviewing damage estimates to confirm vehicles are total losses.
Your role will also be responsible for handling an inventory of claims, triaging critical claims, and delivering service to all constituents of the claim.
The ideal candidate has a willingness to work through a design process that supports the quickest claim resolution with the best outcome. In addition, you will collaborate closely with our product and engineering teams to give feedback and identify technology and process improvements.
What you'll do

• Provide prompt, courteous and high-quality customer service to all policyholders and claimants by answering customer calls and resolving customer requests

• Gather necessary information from customers to successfully adjudicate the claim and explain policy, coverage, and appropriate course of action

• Manage an inventory of claims, establish initial reserves for all potential exposures, and adjust as appropriate throughout the claim

• Coordinate with our salvage vendor partners for the movement of damaged vehicles and assist with rental reimbursement

• Recognize recovery opportunities in regards to subrogation and salvage, as well as total loss

• Ensure compliance with specific state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures

• Negotiating and communicating all total loss settlements per company and state guidelines within approved payment authority

• Provide input for continuous development of claims guidelines, best practices, and process improvements

• Oversee and direct outside investigative service providers and work closely with the client and client counsel and investigative services to resolve the claim

• Engage in learning opportunities to build knowledge of personal lines claims, court decisions impacting the claims function, current guidelines in claims function, and policy changes and modifications

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)

• Minimum of 3 years of experience on point and concentrated in transportation claims adjusting, ideally with:

•

• Total Loss adjusting experience

• First-party Comp and Collision

• Third-party Property Damage Liability

• Active insurance adjuster’s license by way of a designated home state, or home state

• Willing to obtain all licenses within 60 days, including completing state required testing

• Knowledge of state regulations, policy provisions, and standard operating procedures

• Commercial experience preferred

• Ability to analyze and evaluate complex data and make sound decisions based on established guidelines, policies, and procedures

Who We Are

At YallaPlay , We are a rapidly growing startup mobile gaming studio on a mission to bring people together through play, we create exciting mobile games that bring joy to millions of players worldwide. Founded in Austin, Texas, we’ve since expanded to Brazil and the UAE, growing our diverse and talented team of creators. Our current titles, including “Spades Masters” (iOS/Android), have been enjoyed by millions of players globally.

Our passion lies in reinventing card games infusing them with fresh mechanics, beautiful design, and social features that spark connection and excitement. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for creative, driven individuals who are excited to help shape the future of multiplayer mobile gaming in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Join us and be part of building something big from the ground up.

The Opportunity

We’re building a new rapid-prototyping capability at YallaPlay focused on turning game ideas into complete playable experiences quickly, using AI to dramatically shorten the path from concept to validation.

We’re looking for a Senior Game Prototype Engineer who can independently design and build game prototypes from A to Z. You’ll sit at the intersection of game design, frontend engineering, backend engineering, and UI/UX, taking an initial concept and turning it into something players can actually play and evaluate.

This is not a role where you wait for detailed game designs, UX specifications, or technical requirements. You’ll define the core gameplay, design the player experience, build the client and supporting backend, create or source the assets needed, and deliver a complete playable prototype.

Your job is not to build production-ready games. It is to identify what needs to be tested and build the fastest complete experience capable of answering that question.

You’ll work heavily with AI coding agents and modern development tools to move from idea → design → prototype → playtest → learning → next experiment at high speed.

Some prototypes will survive. Most won’t. That’s expected. Success means helping us discover which ideas deserve further investment before we commit a full production team.

This position can be remote or based at our state-of-the-art offices in Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Take game ideas from concept to complete playable prototype, owning the process from A to Z.

• Define and iterate on the core game mechanics, rules, player flows, controls, progression, and overall gameplay experience.

• Design and implement clear, functional UI/UX that allows players to understand and properly experience the game.

• Build the frontend, game logic, bots, lightweight backend, multiplayer functionality, and other systems required to make the prototype fully playable.

• Use existing, generated, or placeholder art, animation, audio, and other assets to create a prototype that feels complete enough to evaluate fairly.

• Scope ideas down to their smallest meaningful testable version, focusing effort on what needs to be proven rather than building unnecessary features.

• Own the prototype loop end to end: define the hypothesis, build the experience, run playtests, analyze the results, and recommend whether to iterate, progress, or stop.

• Use AI coding agents and AI-assisted development tools as a core part of your workflow to dramatically increase development speed.

• Instrument prototypes with lightweight analytics where needed so decisions can be informed by player behavior as well as qualitative feedback.

• Iterate rapidly based on playtests, data, and feedback.

• When a prototype graduates, package the game rules, learnings, technical approach, and playable build for handoff to the production team.

• Continuously experiment with new AI tools, frameworks, and workflows
